# Project bootstrap workflow

1. Establish outcome, users, constraints, deployment/runtime target and success evidence.
2. Research only decisions that are materially open.
3. Select stack/architecture with explicit trade-offs.
4. Create the minimum project structure and canonical AGENTS.md.
5. Establish build/test/lint/run commands.
6. Implement one thin vertical slice proving the stack works end to end.
7. Add documentation for setup, architecture map and known constraints.
8. Run clean verification from a fresh-enough state.
9. Record unresolved decisions rather than hiding them in boilerplate.

Avoid generating a huge framework before the first real flow is proven.
